project.name: chopped-by-diego
project.productType: one-page local-service site (solo barber, Northwest Houston) — phone-first, Booksy inline booking

colors.rules: cream is the ink of the page; signal is punctuation only — NEVER a button fill (Oryzo rule); warm walnut canvas, never pure black; hairlines carve layout (Hyperstudio)

typography.display: Bricolage Grotesque (variable: opsz 12..96, wdth 75..100, wght 300..600) — weight 300–500, negative tracking, oversized; the name WHISPERS
typography.quote: Newsreader italic 300 (opsz axis) — one italic line per screen max, his words only
typography.mono: Azeret Mono 400/500 — every label, duration, price, caption, mast (the third voice)

spacing.rhythm: off-grid (14/22/34), generous void above the fold ≥40%

radius.policy: committed sharp for surfaces; pills only for buttons

shadows.policy: none — depth by hairline, grain, vignette

motion.signature: variable-font weight/width breathing on the name; hairlines draw on; mask reveals; contextual cursor label; freehand-line SVG preloader

design.density: editorial — one idea per screen on phone

preferredPrimitives: outlined cream pill button with corner-bracket draw-on (21st Motion Button / Dot Border Button mechanics)
hairline rate rows with mono numerals
void-mode photo plate with mono caption
patterns: Booksy inline widget (mode=inline, id 1668896) as the silent last section

must: all copy in Diego's own voice
real photos only — 22 assets in hand, no stock, no AI imagery, no Higgsfield
ONE conversion verb wired to Booksy
divergence contact-sheet run vs AJR/Sleek/Rigos before any render is shown
every component sourced from 21st.dev first (mechanism), rebuilt on our clock + tokens
avoid: tracked 11px uppercase eyebrows below readable size

NO singular hero object; smooth subtle motion distributed through the site
